import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
import stripe
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_placeholder'
PRICE_CENTS_PER_GB = 25

def purchase_note_storage_upgrade(customer_id: str, extra_gb: int) -> dict:
    amount = extra_gb * PRICE_CENTS_PER_GB
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    payment_method = customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method
    # Cancel abandoned storage purchase attempts so they cannot be confirmed later
    for stale in stripe.PaymentIntent.list(customer=customer_id, limit=20).data:
        if stale.status == 'requires_payment_method' and (stale.description or '').endswith('GB note storage'):
            stripe.PaymentIntent.cancel(stale.id)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=payment_method, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'{extra_gb} GB note storage')
    return {'payment_intent': intent.id, 'amount_cents': amount, 'status': intent.status}
